meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你查看、添加或移除允许 agent 容器访问的主机目录，并设置每个目录是只读还是可读写。修改后，新启动的容器会自动用新规则，已运行的容器需重启对应组才能生效。
howto.when: 当你说到“mounts”“mount allowlist”等关键词，或要求查看/添加/移除 agent 可访问的目录时触发。

say.text: 显示允许 agent 访问的目录清单
say.note: 读取并展示挂载允许列表
验证目录后写入允许列表
删除该目录的访问配置

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can view, add, or remove host directories allowed for agent containers, and set each as read-only or read-write. Changes apply to newly spawned containers automatically; running containers need a group restart.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "mounts", "mount allowlist", "container mounts", etc., or when you ask to manage which directories agents can access.

say_en.text: Show the list of directories currently allowed for agents.
say_en.note: Reads and displays the mount allowlist.
Validates the path and writes it to the allowlist.
